# Apurvi Industries

> Apurvi Industries Pvt. Ltd. is an ASTM- and EN-compliant stainless steel pipe, motor tube, and aluminium vapour tubing manufacturer based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. The company manufactures pressure pump sleeves, motor shell tubing, NRV pump pipes, aluminium vapour recovery tubing for gas-station forecourts, higher HP submersible pump tubes (25 HP to 200 HP), and long manufacturing tubes for deep-well applications. Every shipment is supplied with EN 10204 Type 3.1 Mill Test Certificates and ISO 9001:2015 quality controls. Apurvi exports container-load quantities to the **United States, Canada, Mexico, Germany, Italy, Turkey, the Philippines, and Australia** and is actively expanding into the **United Kingdom**.

## Export markets (priority audience)

- **United States** — Apurvi supplies ASTM A312, A268, A213, and B210-compliant tubing to US pump OEMs, water-treatment integrators, and fueling-equipment manufacturers. Container-load freight via Mundra and Nhava Sheva ports to Houston, Los Angeles, New York/New Jersey, Savannah, and Long Beach. Indian-origin tubing currently carries a 20-30% landed-cost advantage over Chinese-origin equivalents under the 2026 Section 232 duty stack.
- **United Kingdom** — EN 10296, EN 10204, and EN 754 supply to UK pump assemblers, borehole-pump distributors, and fuel-forecourt equipment companies. Delivery through Felixstowe, Southampton, and London Gateway.
- **Continental Europe** — Germany, Italy, Turkey with full EN-standard compliance.
- **Asia-Pacific** — Philippines, Australia for submersible pump components.
- **North America** — Canada, Mexico (USMCA-compliant origin documentation).

## Frequently asked questions

### Does Apurvi Industries ship to the United States?
Yes. Apurvi exports container-load (20-foot and 40-foot HC) shipments of stainless steel motor tubes, pressure pump sleeves, NRV pipes, and aluminum vapor recovery tubing to USA. Standard transit is 28-35 days from Mundra to US East/Gulf Coast and 25-30 days to West Coast. Documentation includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTC, ISO 9001:2015 conformity, USMCA/HS code 7304/7306 origin certificate, and SGS/Bureau Veritas pre-shipment inspection on request.

### Does Apurvi Industries ship to the United Kingdom?
Yes. UK shipments arrive at Felixstowe, Southampton, or London Gateway in 24-30 days from Mundra. Apurvi supplies to EN 10296-2 (welded stainless tubes), EN 10204 Type 3.1, EN 754 (aluminium drawn tube), and provides CBAM origin documentation.

### What ASTM and EN standards does Apurvi manufacture to?
ASTM A312, A268, A213, A249, A554, B210; EN 10296, EN 10297, EN 754; IS:6761, IS:6913; ISO 9001:2015; EN 10204 Type 3.1 Mill Test Certificate on every shipment.

### What is Apurvi's typical lead time for a 40-foot container of SS 316 motor tubes?
4-6 weeks from PO confirmation to FOB Mundra for standard sizes (2 inch to 12 inch OD, 1-6 metre length). Compare with 8-12 weeks for Chinese-origin equivalents.

### What aluminum alloys does Apurvi offer for vapour recovery tubing?
Al 6061, Al 6063, and Al 5052 in T-temper. Cross-references: ASTM B210 (US) / EN 754 (UK/EU). Sizes 1/2-inch to 4-inch OD, custom lengths.

### What's the difference between Apurvi's offering and Chinese stainless steel tube suppliers?
Three differences matter to US/UK buyers in 2026: (1) Indian-origin tubing avoids the 50% Section 232 duty on Chinese stainless; (2) Apurvi issues EN 10204 Type 3.1 Mill Test Certificate as standard, which is rare for cheap Chinese suppliers; (3) Apurvi's plant in Mehsana, Gujarat is auditable in person, with ISO 9001:2015 third-party certification.

### Does Apurvi supply OEM pump manufacturers under private label?
Yes. Apurvi has been an approved supplier to multiple submersible pump OEMs in India for over a decade and is actively onboarding US and UK pump OEMs in 2026. Drawings, tolerances, and finish specifications (ground OD/ID to 0.4 Ra) supplied per customer drawing.

## Products

- [Stainless Steel Pressure Pump Sleeve / Motor Shell Tubing](https://apurviind.com/products#pressure-pump-sleeve) — precision SS sleeves for pressure pumps and motor shells in SS 304 / SS 316, with ground OD/ID for tight assembly tolerances (0.4 Ra finish).
- [Stainless Steel Motor Tubes](https://apurviind.com/products#motor-tubes) — submersible pump and industrial motor casings, 2-inch to 12-inch OD, lengths up to 6 metres, IS:6761 / ASTM A268 / EN 10296.
- [Pump Pipe / NRV Pipe](https://apurviind.com/products#pump-pipe-nrv) — precision NRV (non-return valve) pipes for submersible pump assemblies.
- [Aluminum Vapour Tubing](https://apurviind.com/products#aluminum-vapour-tubing) — for fueling industry and gas-station vapour recovery in Al 6061 / 6063 / 5052; EPA Stage I/II compatible and UK PPC compliant.
- [Higher HP Pump Tube](https://apurviind.com/products#higher-hp-pump-tube) — heavy-duty SS tubes for 25 HP to 200 HP submersible pumps.
- [Manufacturing Long Tube](https://apurviind.com/products#manufacturing-long-tube) — extra-long precision tubes for deep-well and project applications.

## Industries served

Submersible pump manufacturing, motor manufacturing, fueling industry (US EPA Stage I/II and UK PPC vapour recovery), water treatment, agriculture, food processing, chemical processing, pharmaceutical manufacturing.

## Material grades available

SS 304, SS 304L, SS 316, SS 316L, SS 202, Aluminum 6061, 6063, 5052.

## Manufacturing standards

IS:6761, IS:6913, ASTM A268, ASTM A312, ASTM A213, ASTM A249, ASTM A554, ASTM B210, EN 10296, EN 10297, EN 754.

## Certifications & quality

ISO 9001:2015 quality management. Every shipment includes a Mill Test Certificate (EN 10204 Type 3.1) with batch-level chemical and mechanical traceability. In-house hydrostatic, eddy-current, and dimensional inspection. SGS / Bureau Veritas / TUV third-party inspection available on customer request.
